Module ru.ashemchuk.task_2_3_1
Package ru.ashemchuk.model.snake

Class PlayerSnake

java.lang.Object
ru.ashemchuk.model.snake.Snake
ru.ashemchuk.model.snake.PlayerSnake
public class PlayerSnake extends Snake
Represents the player-controlled snake. Handles movement, growth, shrinking, and turning with restrictions (no 180-degree turns).
